title: Jumbled Sentence 96
subject: History
caption: Flowchart showing how to reorder a jumbled sentence into the correct sequence Q → R → P → S.
altText: A flowchart begins with a node labeled 'Jumbled Sentence (Q R P S)' leading to 'Identify parts'. From there four branches represent Part Q, Part R, Part P, and Part S. All four converge on an 'Ordered sequence' node, which points to 'Rearranged Sentence Q → R → P → S', then to 'Check grammar and meaning', and finally to 'Correct Sentence'. The start and final nodes are highlighted as important.
